title: prunus × donarium var. compta
intro: Prunus × donarium var. compta, commonly known as the Plum Blossom or Japanese Apricot, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the Rosaceae family. The health benefits of this plant include its antioxidant properties, which help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Prunus × donarium var. compta include its use in traditional medicine to treat conditions such as fever, cough, and digestive issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
